name: Levetiracetam
description: Levetiracetam is an anticonvulsant medication used to control seizures.
mechanism: Modulates synaptic neurotransmitter release by affecting SV2A receptors in neurons.

name: Sodium Valproate
description: A medication used for seizure control and certain neurological disorders.
mechanism: Enhances inhibitory neurotransmission through increased GABA activity.

name: Sertraline
description: An antidepressant medication used for mood and anxiety disorders.
mechanism: Increases serotonin availability between neurons.

name: Sumatriptan
description: A medicine used for acute migraine attacks.
mechanism: Activates serotonin receptors involved in migraine pain pathways.

name: Amlodipine
description: A blood pressure medication that relaxes blood vessels.
mechanism: Blocks calcium entry into vascular smooth muscle causing vasodilation.

name: Atorvastatin
description: A cholesterol-lowering medication used to reduce cardiovascular risk.
mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing LDL cholesterol production.

name: Salbutamol
description: A rapid-relief inhaled medicine used to open narrowed airways.
mechanism: Relaxes airway smooth muscle through beta-2 receptor stimulation.

name: Budesonide
description: An anti-inflammatory medicine used for chronic airway inflammation.
mechanism: Reduces inflammatory immune responses in airway tissues.

name: Omeprazole
description: A medicine that reduces stomach acid production.
mechanism: Blocks gastric proton pumps responsible for acid secretion.

name: Metformin
description: A first-line medicine commonly used for type 2 diabetes.
mechanism: Improves insulin sensitivity and reduces liver glucose production.

name: Insulin
description: A hormone therapy used to control blood glucose levels.
mechanism: Allows glucose entry into cells and lowers blood glucose levels.

name: Levothyroxine
description: A replacement form of thyroid hormone T4.
mechanism: Restores normal thyroid hormone levels.
sideEffects: Rapid heartbeat if dose is excessive

name: Nitrofurantoin
description: An antibiotic commonly used for urinary tract infections.
mechanism: Damages bacterial DNA and inhibits bacterial growth.

name: Alendronate
description: A medicine used to strengthen bones and reduce fracture risk.
mechanism: Reduces osteoclast activity and slows bone breakdown.

name: Methotrexate
description: An immune-modulating medicine used for autoimmune inflammatory diseases.
mechanism: Reduces immune system activity involved in inflammation.

name: Isotretinoin
description: A powerful medication used for severe acne.
mechanism: Reduces oil gland activity and prevents acne formation.

name: Carbidopa-Levodopa
description: A combination medicine that increases dopamine activity in the brain and is commonly used to improve movement symptoms in Parkinson disease.
uses: Movement symptoms caused by dopamine deficiency
mechanism: Levodopa is converted into dopamine in the brain, while carbidopa reduces breakdown of levodopa before it reaches the brain.

name: Donepezil
description: A medicine used to improve cognitive symptoms in some patients with Alzheimer disease.
mechanism: Increases acetylcholine availability in the brain by inhibiting acetylcholinesterase.

name: Memantine
description: A medication used for moderate to severe Alzheimer disease to help manage cognitive symptoms.
mechanism: Regulates glutamate activity by blocking excessive NMDA receptor stimulation.

name: Aspirin
description: A medicine that reduces platelet aggregation and is used in selected cardiovascular conditions to reduce clot formation.
uses: Prevention of blood clot-related cardiovascular events
mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits platelet COX enzymes, reducing thromboxane production and platelet activation.

name: Clopidogrel
description: A medicine that prevents platelets from forming harmful blood clots.
mechanism: Blocks platelet P2Y12 receptors, reducing platelet activation.

name: Furosemide
description: A diuretic medicine that helps remove excess fluid from the body.
uses: High blood pressure in selected cases
mechanism: Increases urine production by blocking sodium and chloride reabsorption in the kidneys.

name: Amoxicillin-Clavulanate
description: A broad-spectrum antibiotic combination used for several bacterial infections.
mechanism: Amoxicillin blocks bacterial cell wall formation while clavulanate inhibits beta-lactamase enzymes.

name: Azithromycin
description: An antibiotic used against certain bacterial respiratory infections.
mechanism: Blocks bacterial protein synthesis by binding to bacterial ribosomes.

name: Rifampicin
description: A key antibiotic used as part of combination therapy for tuberculosis.
mechanism: Inhibits bacterial RNA polymerase, preventing RNA synthesis.

name: Isoniazid
description: A first-line medicine used in combination therapy for tuberculosis treatment.
mechanism: Inhibits synthesis of mycolic acids required for bacterial cell walls.

name: Allopurinol
description: A medicine that lowers uric acid levels and helps prevent gout attacks.
mechanism: Blocks xanthine oxidase, reducing uric acid production.

name: Colchicine
description: A medicine used to reduce inflammation during gout attacks.
mechanism: Reduces inflammatory response caused by uric acid crystals.

name: Hydrocortisone
description: A corticosteroid medicine used to reduce skin inflammation and itching.
mechanism: Suppresses inflammatory immune responses in skin tissues.

name: Tenofovir
description: An antiviral medicine used for chronic hepatitis B infection management.
mechanism: Blocks viral reverse transcriptase, reducing viral replication.

name: Oseltamivir
description: An antiviral medicine used for influenza treatment when started early.
mechanism: Blocks influenza neuraminidase enzyme, limiting viral spread.

name: Metoprolol
description: A medicine used to reduce heart rate and decrease workload on the heart.
mechanism: Blocks beta-adrenergic receptors, reducing heart rate and cardiac workload.
